signal.reasoning: I can understand the financial record, though it tells me less about the durability of the moat: 49% gross margins, 28% net margins, rising revenue growth and free cash flow above earnings are strong evidence of a fine business. At 37.5 times earnings, I would want more assurance that these returns can endure before committing to own it for ten years.
